load_inference_model: load a machine learning inference model from a checkpoint file with optional config overrides and EMA support
get_backbone_class_from_checkpoint: extract the backbone model class from a checkpoint's configuration using the registry
load_tasks: load and instantiate Task objects from a checkpoint file's tasks configuration
update_configs: recursively update a configuration dictionary with new values, merging nested dicts
tf32_context_manager: use a context manager to temporarily enable TF32 precision for CUDA matmul and cuDNN operations
